text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF remain bearish on Monday and are likely to head back down towards 127.10 over the next few days, but for this session they may consolidate, technical analysts said.

"I'm still pretty negative of notionnel and overall I'm looking for a move down to around 127.10. That is the objective over the next few days," said Miranda Churchill, a London based technical analyst.
That level is just above the low for April at 127.06 which was formed on April 3 and 4.
At 0819 GMT, June notionnel futures were up 0.08 at 128.36.
Churchill said for Monday's session initial support was offered at 128.30. On daily charts that was the low on March 17, when the contract broke lower, and is the low so far this session.

"But the real key level is 128.00," she said. "It is almost a three week low and is psychological. If we can break down through that then there is not much support until we get down to around 127.00."
Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, said while notionnel was negative in the short to medium term, there would probably be some consolidation on Monday.

"The notionnel has rebounded quite strongly from Friday's lows and seems to be outperforming Bunds," he said. "But we had a decent break lower on Friday, which suggests a potential top at 129.38 and we are probably likely to see a bit of sideways action today."
Wilkin said the range for this session was likely to be between Friday's low at 128.06 and 128.94, the April 24 high.
"Then we will fall into line with Bunds, looking for it to break lower," he said.
He cited support at 128.04, April 14 low, and then further support at 127.06.
To the upside, Churchill said resistance was at 128.62, the high so far this session, and above there at 128.76, the level on a downwards trendline.
"I would only change my view if it rose up through 128.76," she said.
Wilkin said only a push through 129.38 would signal a stronger rally, but the contract would first need to get through 128.94, Thursday's high.
At the short end, June Pibor futures were at 96.33, up four basis points on the day.
